intro: Braelyn Firehand is an elven practitioner of the arcane residing quietly among the Horde at Sun Rock Retreat in the Stonetalon Mountains. Claiming an interest in clearing mystical obstructions across the highlands, she enlists travelers to strike against the night elven guardians of Stonetalon Peak.

p: Standing out amidst the tauren lodges and rustic orcish tents of Sun Rock Retreat, Braelyn Firehand is a rare sight: a blood elf dwelling openly within a remote Horde settlement. The shaman and chieftains of the retreat tolerate her presence, seemingly oblivious to her true loyalties. Braelyn presents herself as an observer fascinated by the flow of regional magic, eager to hire passing Horde mercenaries to handle dangerous field assignments across the crags.
